text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold winners to lock in gains; I should not trim a stock just because it is above my average cost, but weigh its prospects and portfolio role.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me cling to losing positions and sell winners too soon. I should assess each holding objectively, including whether my original thesis still holds.","Frequent monitoring can encourage unnecessary trades. Before acting, I should consider the whole portfolio and whether the trade improves it, rather than reacting to short-term price moves or the pleasure of realizing a gain."]}
